title: Cabina AI — Native Voice Cabin
content_html:
The Hook: Remote knowledge workers collaborating with global teams frequently experience intense anxiety and cognitive fatigue during live meetings (specifically Google Meet). Existing translation tools either rely on intrusive meeting bots (like Otter.ai or Fireflies.ai) that trigger strict corporate security blocks, or create chaotic audio interference by overlapping foreign speech with robotic voices at steep monthly subscription costs ($15–$30/mo).

Cabina AI solves this as a stealth, client-side Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) acting as a private, personalized 'voice cabin' directly inside the user's headset—providing real-time bidirectional speech interpretation with 100% data privacy via a Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) architecture.

5 Core Product Pillars & Engineering Highlights

  • Direct Tab Audio Capture & Low-Latency Streaming: Intercepts meeting audio digitally using chrome.tabCapture and an Offscreen Document, encoding raw high-definition PCM streams and establishing direct bi-directional WebSocket connections to Google Gemini (gemini-3.5-live-translate-preview) and OpenAI (gpt-realtime-translate) with zero intermediate server hops.
  • Intelligent Whisper Mode & Audio Ducking: Custom audio regulation algorithm that dynamically ducks original Google Meet meeting audio to 20% whenever the AI voice interpreter is speaking, smoothly restoring it to 100% (fade-in 150ms) when quiet. This allows the user to retain natural conversational nuance and vocal inflections while hearing crystal-clear translations without audio clash.
  • Stealth Privacy Guard: Integrated an automated StealthDetector (observing DOM mutations and screen-sharing events) that automatically hides the Cabina sidebar and floating badges the instant screen sharing is initiated, protecting professional confidence and presentation aesthetics.
  • Automated AI Meeting Minutes: Instantly aggregates post-call transcripts to generate structured Markdown summaries—categorizing High-Level Summaries, Action Items with assigned owners, and key strategic decisions ready for 1-click export to Slack and Microsoft Teams.
  • Industry-Specific Vocabulary Models: Tailored context-injection prompts for technical engineering (Kubernetes, microservices), finance/crypto (TVL, APY, liquidity pools), and healthcare to ensure domain terminology is interpreted with zero hallucination.

Business & Monetization Model

  • Hybrid BYOK + Software License: Users retain complete control over their API keys and quotas directly with Google/OpenAI, paired with an ultra-affordable software license ($4.99/year via Polar/Lemon Squeezy) offering a generous 30-day free trial.

title: PM No-Code: AI Product Management & Automation
content_html:
The Hook: Transitioning from traditional software delivery to modern AI-driven product management requires bridging the gap between strategic Product Ownership and frontier technical implementation. PM No-Code is a comprehensive, production-grade masterclass and systems framework designed to empower Product Managers, founders, and operators to architect digital products, deploy autonomous AI Agents, and automate end-to-end operational workflows without writing code.

Grounded directly in real-world product management experience across large-scale FinTech, B2B2C, and SaaS platforms, this project demonstrates end-to-end curriculum design, full-stack video studio automation, and technical architecture.

Core Focus & Practical Competencies

  • Product Management & AI Strategy: Establishing robust mental models from product discovery and roadmap prioritization to hands-on deployment of modern AI architectures (ML, Deep Learning, Transformer, Multimodal) into operational business systems.
  • Advanced Prompt Engineering & No-Code Automation: Mastering structured prompt frameworks (CRAFT, RACE, Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot), context window optimization, and integrating low-code workflow automations using Claude Code, n8n, Zapier, and Make to accelerate feature delivery.
  • Autonomous AI Agents & System Operations: Designing agentic architectures (Function Calling, ReAct Framework, Multi-Agent Orchestration), system evaluation metrics (RAG Triad Metric, LLM Benchmarking, AI Observability), and vertical applications across FinTech, Healthcare, and E-Commerce.
  • Production Pipeline & Studio Automation: Engineered a dedicated Studio Manager automation engine (app.py) incorporating automated PPTX-to-Keynote slide conversion, FFmpeg delogo watermark removal, and scene-cut detection to produce 92 high-definition video lectures.

Comprehensive 8-Phase Curriculum Architecture (92 Lectures)

  • Phase 1: Foundations & Mathematics for AI: Machine Learning paradigms, Linear Algebra (vectors, matrix transformations), Probability & Statistics (Bayesian inference, probability distributions), and Differential Calculus (gradients, loss surfaces, optimization).
  • Phase 2: Classical Machine Learning & Analytics: Supervised algorithms (Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, SVM, KNN), Unsupervised clustering (K-Means, DBSCAN, PCA), and rigorous evaluation metrics (Confusion Matrix, F1-Score, Bias vs. Variance tradeoff).
  • Phase 3: Office AI, Low-Code Automation & Governance: Advanced Prompt Engineering frameworks (CRAFT, RACE, Chain-of-Thought, Few-Shot), automated low-code integrations (n8n, Make, Zapier), and Enterprise AI security policies.
  • Phase 4: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures: Perceptrons, Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs), Backpropagation dynamics, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Recurrent Networks (RNN, LSTM, GRU).
  • Phase 5: NLP, Transformers, LLMs & Multimodal AI: Self-Attention mechanisms, Transformer architectures (BERT, GPT, T5), Subword Tokenization (BPE, WordPiece), Fine-Tuning pipelines, and Multimodal Vision-Language Models.
  • Phase 6: Alignment, Reasoning & Autonomous Agents: RLHF, DPO, Constitutional AI, Test-Time Compute, ReAct frameworks, Tool Calling, and multi-agent coordination.
  • Phase 7: MLOps, Evaluation & Production Security: Model deployment pipelines, continuous latency monitoring, concept drift detection, adversarial red teaming, and prompt injection mitigation.
  • Phase 8: Practical Industry Implementations: Specialized end-to-end verticals spanning FinTech algorithmic trading, Computer Vision in precision healthcare, smart agriculture IoT, and enterprise recommendation engines.

title: Voicemaker AI - Neural TTS Converter
content_html:
Voicemaker AI is a high-performance, real-time Neural Text-to-Speech (TTS) converter web application designed to synthesize natural-sounding speech from text using state-of-the-art AI voice models.

AI Technology & Implementation

  • Neural Synthesis Engines: Integrates Microsoft Azure Cognitive Services Neural TTS and Google Cloud Text-to-Speech APIs, utilizing advanced WaveNet, Tacotron 2, and FastSpeech deep learning architectures to generate highly expressive, natural human voices.
  • Audio Parameter Tuning: Implemented real-time client-side controls for dynamic adjustment of speech rate (speaking speed), pitch shifting (semitones), and volume gain, mapping directly to API payload configurations.
  • Semantic Chunking & Pipeline Streaming: Developed a smart text-segmentation algorithm that splits inputs at logical semantic and clause boundaries (e.g., punctuation, clause breaks) to stay within API length limits while maintaining semantic integrity. Chunks are generated concurrently and played back-to-back using a custom Web Audio API queuing buffer to ensure seamless, zero-latency playback.
  • Local State & Usage Analytics: Developed client-side local caching and monthly character count tracking (via localStorage) to optimize API quota management and monitor synthesis usage.

title: UStillAlive - Safety Circle
content_html:
The Hook: Personal safety applications often compromise user privacy by constantly tracking background locations, leading to severe battery drain and trust issues. UStillAlive solves this by introducing an activity-driven connection network—enabling families and trusted circles to monitor reachability seamlessly without continuous GPS surveillance, while maintaining robust, instant emergency dispatch capabilities.

As an Independent Product Manager, this project demonstrates my ability to handle end-to-end product architecture, translate core safety-critical mechanics into stable system logic, and leverage advanced technical frameworks to launch a functional utility application from scratch.

Core Technical Implementation

  • Heartbeat Sync & Activity Signals: Engineered a background synchronization lifecycle that transmits low-overhead "heartbeat" signals from the device to monitor system state. This approach calculates reachability statuses (Active, Warning, or Inactive) based on check-in deltas instead of persistent tracking.
  • Conditional Location & Address Reverse-Geocoding: Integrated GPS location services to trigger on-demand only when an SOS event is activated. Implemented backend reverse-geocoding APIs to instantly translate coordinates into a precise physical address string for emergency recipients.
  • Asynchronous Emergency Dispatching: Designed a robust, queue-based SOS architecture. When a user triggers an alert, the system packs the payload (phone number, coordinates, timestamp, and address) and guarantees delivery across the circle via real-time data streams.

Infrastructure & Tech Stack

  • Real-time Infrastructure: Utilized Firebase Realtime Database and Cloud Firestore to manage safety status matrix distributions and handle instant peer-to-peer circle mapping changes with sub-second latencies.
  • Cloud & Compute: Deployed decoupled Cloud Functions to process intensive tasks, such as validating device timeouts, state mutations, and triggering automated APNs/FCM push notification payloads.
  • Security & Privacy Guardrails: Enforced data isolation using Firestore Security Rules, ensuring emergency payloads and status updates are strictly accessible to authorized, user-defined guardians.

title: Cổ Học Phương Đông
content_html:
The Hook: Traditional Eastern philosophy and classical texts are rich in wisdom but highly complex, unstructured, and difficult for modern users to interpret accurately. Eastern Classics (Cổ Học Phương Đông) solves this by transforming static historical knowledge into an interactive, AI-powered digital platform—making ancient wisdom accessible, contextualized, and engaging for everyone.

As a non-coder Product Manager, this project showcases my ability to leverage practical AI-assisted development (Vibe Coding) to solo-engineer and deploy a fully functional mobile application from scratch, handling the entire product lifecycle from prompt-driven coding to production launch.

Core Technical Implementation

  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG): Architected the system logic to combine digitized classical reference materials with RAG, ensuring the AI model retrieves and references authoritative knowledge sources instead of generating hallucinated answers.
  • Large Language Models (LLMs): Integrated LLM capabilities via API to power a context-aware analysis engine capable of interpreting complex philosophical concepts based on individual user questions.
  • Interactive Learning Workflows: Designed a multi-turn conversational interface that enables users to progressively deepen their understanding with follow-up queries and track their research history.

Vibe Coding & Tech Stack

  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Handled 100% of the mobile application development, system logic, and cloud integration by utilizing advanced LLMs as programming co-pilots (Vibe Coding) to generate and debug clean code.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Deployed a scalable architecture utilizing Firebase for database management, user authentication, and Cloud Functions to securely handle real-time API communications and knowledge retrieval.

title: M2C/B2B2C Ecosystem
content_html:
'Tiệm Số Hóa' Super-App is an end-to-end Manufacturer-to-Consumer (M2C) digital commerce platform designed to digitize traditional 'mom-and-pop' retail shops into high-tech service hubs.

As the Lead Product Owner (Acting Product Manager), I was responsible for shaping the product strategy and aligning the multi-stage roadmap. In this role, I served as the central point of contact, working directly with C-level executives and key Business Units (BUs) to translate business goals and commercial targets into functional features, successfully managing the phased rollout across B2B Supply Chain, Omnichannel, FinTech, and Gamification & Loyalty domains.

Key Execution & Metrics

  • Roadmap Execution & Growth: Delivered features on time according to the product roadmap, helping expand the user base past 325K+ and driving a 4x MAU surge to peak at 93K+ active merchants.
  • FinTech System Integration: Managed the integration roadmap to bring core FinTech modules (E-wallet, QR Payments, Lending, Bill Pay) from backend services into the Super-App interface, enabling the platform to process over 220K+ monthly FinTech transactions.
  • UX/UI Optimization: Redesigned and optimized the interface layouts and workflows, successfully cutting user task engagement time by 2.5x while sustaining 73K+ re-engaged merchants monthly via automated lifecycle campaigns.
  • AI Capability Integration: Evaluated trade-offs and led the integration of 3rd-party Computer Vision and Chatbot capabilities to enhance platform technology and automate user support interactions.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Coordinated cross-functional teams (Engineering, Design, Operations) and balanced requirements from Tier-1 corporate commercial accounts (Kido, Thọ Phát, Ajinomoto, Vifon, Hương Thủy, etc.) to ensure on-time product delivery.

title: FoodSave App
content_html:
Singapore wastes about 788,600 tonnes of food yearly. Out of this, only 13% is recycled. Singapore spends around $14.8 billion buying food from other countries, yet is one of the top 10 countries in the world with the highest rate of food wastage.

Solutions

An app platform utilizing a sharing economy system that connects B2C and C2C users by integrating food sellers and purchasers, featuring real-time alerts and about-to-expiry notifications on good deals.

Features

  • Merchant Listings: Merchants can list their "before expiry" products in real-time to alert nearby consumers of discount deals.
  • Peer-to-Peer Sharing: Since households contribute significantly to food wastage, users can list their "extra" cooked food or newly purchased items before expiry for nearby users to buy and consume.

title: Wildwest Vietnam
content_html:
A promotional project highlighting the cultures, arts, and travel opportunities within the Mekong Delta provinces.

Known as the 'rice bowl' of Vietnam, the Mekong Delta is carpeted in a dizzying variety of greens. It is a water world that moves to the rhythms of the mighty Mekong, where boats, houses, and markets float upon the innumerable rivers, canals, and streams that criss-cross the landscape like arteries.

The bustling commerce of its towns contrasts sharply with the languid, peaceful pace of life in the countryside. Here, water buffaloes wallow in rice paddies, coconut- and fruit-laden boats float slowly along mud-brown waters, and two-wheeled exploration of narrow lanes is rewarded with a true taste of rural hospitality and delicious local river fish.

Elsewhere, mangrove forests teem with bird life and hold the remnants of historic bunkers, while ornate Khmer pagodas and Buddhist temples reach for the sky, and off-coast islands offer white-sand beaches, tropical hideaways, and historical pirate lore.
